description: Check how recently the local Samsung Health export directory/CSVs were written. Returns mtime, days_since_export, an is_stale flag, and a recommendation. Considered stale if the export is older than 30 days, or older than 7 days with no recent records (the inventory's latest-record date is also older than 7 days). Use before relying on samsung_health_daily_summary or samsung_health_wellness_context to confirm the export is fresh.
name: samsung_health_export_freshness
title: Samsung Health Export Freshness
